name: book
blurb: 3D book mockup that rotates on hover, revealing colored spine and back cover.
description: Renders a 3D book with front cover, spine, and back face using CSS 3D transforms. Rotates on hover unless static. Includes sub-components BookHeader, BookTitle, and BookDescription for layout.
use_when: Showcasing literary works, courses, or content in an engaging 3D presentation.
avoid_when: Mobile-first designs or when 3D transforms are not supported. Requires hover for interaction.
a11y: Content inside is semantic (h1, p, div). 3D rotation is visual-only. No keyboard activation for the hover state.
